title: 1989 BMW 325i
subtitle: Alpine White
summary: Coilovers, basketweaves and the straight six that started it all.
thesis: The car that teaches you how to build. Rear wheel drive, simple mechanicals and a parts world that never dried up. Here is what is on this one and where to get every piece.

parts.note: Wakes up the M20 without highway drone. Stainless, bolt on, one afternoon.
